BiasPrLatRmse.method: Meridional root mean square error of nino3_LatExt pr, time series are linearly detrended, observations and model regridded to generic_1x1deg
BiasPrLatRmse.name: pr Meridional RMSE
BiasPrLatRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

BiasPrLonRmse.method: Zonal root mean square error of equatorial_pacific pr, time series are linearly detrended, observations and model regridded to generic_1x1deg
BiasPrLonRmse.name: pr Zonal RMSE
BiasPrLonRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

BiasSstLonRmse.method: Zonal root mean square error of equatorial_pacific sst, time series are linearly detrended, observations and model regridded to generic_1x1deg
BiasSstLonRmse.name: sst Zonal RMSE
BiasSstLonRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

BiasTauxLonRmse.method: Zonal root mean square error of equatorial_pacific taux, time series are linearly detrended, observations and model regridded to generic_1x1deg
BiasTauxLonRmse.name: taux Zonal RMSE
BiasTauxLonRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

EnsoAmpl.method: Standard deviation of nino3.4 sstA, time series are linearly detrended
EnsoAmpl.name: ENSO amplitude

EnsoDuration.method: nino3.4 SSTA during DEC regressed against nino3.4 SSTA during 6 years (centered on ENSO), the duration is the number of consecutive months during which the regression is above 0.25, time series are linearly detrended, smoothing using a triangle shaped window of 5 points
EnsoDuration.name: ENSO Duration based on life cyle SSTA pattern

EnsoSeasonality.method: Ratio between NDJ and MAM standard deviation nino3.4 sstA, time series are linearly detrended
EnsoSeasonality.name: ENSO seasonality

EnsoSstDiversity_2.method: Nino (Nina) events = nino3.4 sstA > 0.75 (< -0.75) during DEC, zonal SSTA (meridional averaged [-5.0 ; 5.0]), the zonal SSTA maximum (minimum) is located for each event, the diversity is the interquartile range (IQR = Q3 - Q1), time series are linearly detrended, smoothing using a triangle shaped window of 5 points
EnsoSstDiversity_2.name: ENSO Diversity (interquartile range)

EnsoSstLonRmse.method: nino3.4 SSTA during DEC regressed against equatorial_pacific SSTA, time series are linearly detrended, smoothing using a triangle shaped window of 5 points, observations and model regridded to generic_1x1deg
EnsoSstLonRmse.name: ENSO Zonal SSTA pattern
EnsoSstLonRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

EnsoSstSkew.method: Standard deviation of nino3.4 sstA, time series are linearly detrended
EnsoSstSkew.name: ENSO skewness

EnsoSstTsRmse.method: nino3.4 SSTA during DEC regressed against nino3.4 SSTA during 6 years (centered on ENSO), time series are linearly detrended, smoothing using a triangle shaped window of 5 points
EnsoSstTsRmse.name: ENSO life cyle SSTA pattern
EnsoSstTsRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

SeasonalPrLatRmse.method: Meridional root mean square error of nino3_LatExt climatological pr STD, time series are linearly detrended, observations and model regridded to generic_1x1deg
SeasonalPrLatRmse.name: pr meridional seasonality RMSE
SeasonalPrLatRmse.ref: Using xarray/xESMF-compatible regridding and rms (uncentered and biased) calculation

SeasonalPrLonRmse.name: pr zonal seasonality RMSE

SeasonalTauxLonRmse.name: taux zonal seasonality RMSE
